title: Building Improvement Company for Sale in Dubai, UAE
tagline: Business specializes in waterproofing and insulation for concrete and building structures, ensuring that properties stay protected from water damage. - The range of services includes concrete restoration, design and implementation of decorative finishes, as well as painting, carpentry, flooring, false ceilings, lighting, and partitions. - Business has built a solid reputation in the UAE, especially in Dubai, thanks to our 30 skilled employees who handle both on-site applications and back-office operations. - The clientele includes developers, government entities, a major national airline, and high-end hospitality projects, ensuring a consistent stream of work. - Operating for 6 years, our company recorded annual revenues between AED 8M and AED 10M, trending upwards recently to AED 10M to AED 15M, generating net profits of AED 2.5M to AED 3M. - Company is an ISO certified and proud to be approved applicators for leading brands like Sika, Fosroc, Pidilite, Awazel, and Berger Paints, which adds credibility to our services. - We value long-term relationships, having secure maintenance contracts with tier-1 clients, which helps us maintain our strong market presence and competitiveness. - The founder brings over 20 years of experience in the industry, contributing to our operational efficiency and innovative service delivery.
